title_sq: Prane Delijorgjit - Shitet Dyqan Kati 0 tek Ish Parku
description_sq: Shitet dyqan kati 0 tek ish parku autobusave. Dyqani ka nje hapesire prej 25 metrash neto dhe 25 metra ambjent jashte per shfrytezim ne proces legalizimi. Dyqani ka nje vizion te mire pasi ne ate zone per pak fillojne ndertimet dhe do quhet nje zone elitare.
title_en: Near Delijorgji - Shop for sale on the 0th floor in the former park
description_en: Store for sale on the 0th floor at the former bus park. The store has a space of 25 net meters and 25 meters of outdoor space for use in the legalization process. The store has a good vision, as construction will soon begin in that area and it will be called an elite area.
